gloss: to see (someone) safely home; to deliver

definitions.gloss: to see (someone) safely to a place; to deliver
definitions.explanation: To take a person or send a thing all the way to its destination, stressing that it arrived safely.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{送|おく}り{届|とど}ける。
examples.english: To see a child safely home.

examples.japanese: ⟦{酔|よ}った→酔う：14437_you⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦タクシー→タクシー：00816_takushii⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{送|おく}り{届|とど}けた。
examples.english: I took my drunk friend home by taxi.

examples.japanese: ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{午前中|ごぜんちゅう}→午前中：11495_gozenchuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ご{自宅|じたく}→ご自宅：24928_gojitaku⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{送|おく}り{届|とど}けます。
examples.english: We will deliver the package to your home tomorrow morning.

notes:
⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧ (to send; to see someone off) + ⟦{届|とど}ける→届ける：01248_todokeru⟧ (to deliver).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{送|おく}り{届|とど}ける: to see someone home
- ⟦{無事|ぶじ}→無事：01602_buji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{送|おく}り{届|とど}ける: to deliver safely

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧: to send; to take someone somewhere; says nothing about safe arrival
- ⟦{届|とど}ける→届ける：01248_todokeru⟧: to deliver, to take (something) to someone
